import collections
import text

void show(string label, int64[] values)
    println("{label}: {text.join(values, " ")}")

int64[] a := [12, 5, 8, 21, 5, 17, 3, 12, 9]
int64[] b := [8, 14, 21, 6, 14, 3, 25, 6]
left := a.to_distinct()
right := b.to_distinct()
union := left.union(right)
show("union", union.sorted())
show("intersection", left.intersection(right).sorted())
show("difference", left.difference(right).sorted())
show("symmetric difference", left.symmetric_difference(right).sorted())
